project_type: React SPA with Zustand state management, Konva canvas, and pure-function calculation engines
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, test-setup.ts (matchMedia, ResizeObserver mocks)
build_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vite build
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest --run
verification_instructions: Run 'unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npx vitest --run' and confirm all tests pass (901 existing + new integration tests)
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Tests run with 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' to avoid preload module issue.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. Must prefix node/npx commands with 'unset NODE_OPTIONS &&' due to broken preload module path. No Docker available for testing.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass alongside existing 901 tests. Integration tests go in frontend/src/__integration__/ directory.
key_patterns: Engines are pure functions (no mocks needed). Stores use Zustand (create from zustand). Existing integration tests in engines/__tests__/bomPipelineIntegration.test.ts show the pattern. Tests use describe/it/expect from vitest. Path alias @/ maps to src/.
directory_structure: frontend/src/engines/ - pure calculation engines (bomPipeline, wallPanel, light, siteAdaptation, validation, furniture, hiddenComponent); frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores (bom, project, canvas, finalization); frontend/src/canvas/ - canvas components, history, permissions, utils; frontend/src/lib/ - utilities (snapshotBuilder); frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript types (database.ts, canvas.ts)
